items.name: Beginner Big Cubes Ohio 2026
items.information: ### *Please note that this competition takes place at a different venue than the previous Beginner Big Cubes Ohio competitions.* This competition does not include 3x3 and therefore may not be suitable for first-time competitors. Please see [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) for a list of other upcoming competitions in Ohio. This competition also takes place on a **Friday Evening**. Please plan accordingly! Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited. All competitiors will be expected to help during the group they are not competing in.

items.name: UCSD Weeknights IX 2026

venue.name: UC San Diego
venue.address: Student Service Center, 9500 Gilman Dr, La Jolla, CA 92093
venue.details: Student Services Center - Multi Purpose Room

items.information: ## This competition is on a weekday! ​ This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDWeeknightsVIII2025#64161-competitor-responsibilities-faq) tab. ​ **Spectators can attend for free** and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. ​ This competition is organized by the Rubik's Cube Club @ UC San Diego, in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/). ​ ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc4Nzk1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4b75c6f23c4c32d7dde27ffa29729eaef6f4307c/image.png)
